# City Markets (citymarkets.sa)

> Saudi Arabian multi-vendor supermarket delivery platform. Customers
> browse products from local grocery stores, bakeries, and restaurants
> across Riyadh / Jeddah / Dammam. Payment via Moyasar (card, Apple Pay,
> Google Pay) or cash on delivery. AI agent authentication follows the
> Auth.md / OIDC standard.

## API Discovery

- OpenAPI 3.1 spec: <https://citymarkets.sa/openapi.json>
- API catalog (RFC 9727 linkset): <https://citymarkets.sa/.well-known/api-catalog>
- OAuth/OIDC config: <https://citymarkets.sa/.well-known/openid-configuration>
- OAuth protected resource: <https://citymarkets.sa/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource>
- Auth.md guide: <https://citymarkets.sa/auth.md>
- A2A Agent Card: <https://citymarkets.sa/.well-known/agent-card.json>
- MCP Server Card: <https://citymarkets.sa/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json>
- Agent Skills index: <https://citymarkets.sa/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json>
- Universal Commerce Protocol: <https://citymarkets.sa/.well-known/ucp>
- Agentic Commerce Protocol: <https://citymarkets.sa/.well-known/acp.json>

## Public Read Endpoints (no auth required)

- `GET /api/v1/categories` — list all product categories
- `GET /api/v1/products` — paginated product list with filters
- `GET /api/v1/products/:id` — single product detail
- `GET /api/v1/vendors` — list of vendors
- `GET /api/v1/vendors/:id` — single vendor detail
- `GET /api/v1/banners` — homepage hero banners
- `GET /api/v1/delivery/quote` — delivery cost + ETA (POST with address)
- `GET /api/v1/delivery/cities` — supported Saudi cities
- `GET /sitemap.xml` — full product/category sitemap

## Authentication

OAuth 2.0 / OIDC. Phone-based OTP via Twilio for customers; vendor
and admin dashboards use email + password. Client credentials grant
for autonomous agents.

- Scopes: `products:read`, `cart:write`, `orders:read`, `orders:write`,
  `profile`.
- Token TTL: 1 hour (refresh via `refresh_token`).
- Customer JWT cookie: `session_id` (httpOnly, 14 days).

## Conventions

- All API responses are JSON. Dates are ISO 8601 in `Asia/Riyadh`.
- All prices in SAR (halalas = SAR × 100).
- All text fields have `*_ar` and `*_en` variants; the default locale is
  Arabic (Saudi dialect).
- All product images are hosted on Cloudflare R2 at
  `https://cdn.citymarkets.sa/`.

## Content Policy

- `ai-train=no` — don't use our product data to train models.
- `search=yes` — fine to index for search results.
- `ai-input=yes` — fine to feed our content to agents at runtime.
- See `/robots.txt` and the `Content-Signal` response header for the
  machine-readable form.
